_note: The three Baidu downloads were Veer stock-agency photographs (licensing untraceable). The kept photo is the terminal's name board from the Ethiopian News Agency's report on the June 2024 reopening; a duplicate of it and an officials-on-tour photograph were left out.

axu-page-2.webp.zh: 阿克苏姆机场航站楼正面的名称标牌：阿姆哈拉语与英文「AXUM YOHANNES IV AIRPORT」并排，上方是埃塞俄比亚航空的标志（2024 年修复通航后拍摄）。
axu-page-2.webp.en: The name board on Axum airport's terminal — Amharic alongside 'AXUM YOHANNES IV AIRPORT', the Ethiopian Airlines mark above (photographed after the 2024 reopening).

axu-chatgpt-01.webp.zh: 蓝天白云下，红褐色石砌基座的塔台立在带拱形装饰的航站楼旁，花坛边有旅客拖着行李箱走过。
axu-chatgpt-01.webp.en: Under a blue sky, a stone-clad control tower stands beside the arched terminal, with a traveller wheeling a suitcase past the flower beds.

axu-chatgpt-02.webp.zh: 航拍视角下，蓝顶航站楼与大块水泥机坪嵌在黄绿相间的农田之间，跑道从画面下方横穿。
axu-chatgpt-02.webp.en: From the air, a blue-roofed terminal and a wide concrete apron sit among patchwork farmland, with the runway cutting across the lower frame.

axu-chatgpt-03.webp.zh: 烈日下，一架涂有埃塞俄比亚航空字样的双发涡桨客机停在机坪上，舱门开着，登机梯靠在门边。
axu-chatgpt-03.webp.en: In bright sun a twin-turboprop airliner in Ethiopian colours stands on the apron, its cabin door open with boarding steps alongside.

axu-chatgpt-04.webp.zh: 午后阳光斜照，浅色航站楼正面用字母拼出英文机场名称，门前两张长椅空着，左侧墙边靠着一把木梯。
axu-chatgpt-04.webp.en: Late sun rakes across the pale terminal, whose lettered sign spells out the airport's English name, with empty benches below and a ladder propped at the left.

axu-chatgpt-05.webp.zh: 旅客沿着水泥步道走向航站楼入口，拱形门架上方写着阿姆哈拉语与阿克苏姆机场的英文名，两侧草地翠绿。
axu-chatgpt-05.webp.en: Passengers walk up the concrete path to the terminal entrance beneath arched portals lettered in Amharic and English, green lawns on either side.

axu-chatgpt-06.webp.zh: 黄昏时分，一座白色塔台与长条形航站楼被落日染成金色，一架双发涡桨客机停在机坪，远处是林丘与草甸。
axu-chatgpt-06.webp.en: At sunset a small airfield turns gold, a white tower and low terminal beside a parked twin-turboprop, with wooded hills and meadow beyond.
